name: Kinergy Advancement Berhad
overview: 2026年，Kinergy Advancement Berhad 通过 KAB Energy Holdings 签署协议，出售 Jati Cakerawala 49% 股权，涉及可持续能源业务的部分权益退出；同时公司多次进行集资活动。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长11.9%，净利润同比增长39.5%。
overview_en: In 2026, Kinergy Advancement Berhad, through KAB Energy Holdings, entered into an agreement to divest 49% of Jati Cakerawala, involving a partial exit from sustainable energy business interests; the company also conducted multiple fund-raising exercises. In the latest quarter (2026-06-30), revenue grew 11.9% year-on-year and net profit grew 39.5% year-on-year.

segments.name: 可持续能源解决方案
segments.note: 今年通过子公司出售 Jati Cakerawala 49% 股权，涉及可持续能源业务的部分权益退出。
segments.note_en: This year, through a subsidiary, divested 49% equity interest in Jati Cakerawala, involving a partial exit from sustainable energy business interests.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: KAB Energy Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 与 B.Grimm Power Tiara Sdn. Bhd. 签署买卖协议，出售 Jati Cakerawala Sdn. Bhd. 49% 股权（1,960,784 股普通股）。
actions.text_en: KAB Energy Holdings Sdn. Bhd. entered into a sale and purchase agreement with B.Grimm Power Tiara Sdn. Bhd. to divest 49% equity interest (1,960,784 ordinary shares) in Jati Cakerawala Sdn. Bhd.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过出售 Jati Cakerawala 49% 股权，集团在可持续能源业务的部分权益退出。
model_changes.text_en: Through the divestment of 49% equity interest in Jati Cakerawala, the group partially exited its interest in the sustainable energy business.
